annotations.title: Download a DIYA-GL book as a spreadsheet

description: Answers the link to the DIY Accounting Submit page that downloads the open DIYA-GL book as a workbook (xlsx), a package zip, a DIYA-GL zip or a DIYA-GL book as JSON. A product whose spreadsheet is a set of workbooks downloads as a package zip. Use this when the person wants their records as a spreadsheet or a file. It does not change the book.

format.description: xlsx (the default), zip, diya-gl-zip or json
